authority: User requested bidirectional learning between manual decomposition and parallel notes/metrics probes
status: Evidence synthesis for final report and thin skill proposal; no contract or acceptance changes
source_qualification: Directly read current documents. S2 findings and probe outcomes are attributed reports, not independently re-audited implementation claims. Graph marked S2 note metadata_changed; direct full source read used.

incoming_lessons.lesson: Obligation-to-evidence correspondence must distinguish absent evidence, insufficient evidence and uncertainty from adequate discharge.
incoming_lessons.application: Assess demonstrated packet/result/refresh formats for these distinctions; a populated row or passing suite alone is not proof.
incoming_lessons.limit: S2 record-only probe does not establish code violations or universally validate a ledger safeguard.

incoming_lessons.lesson: Finding truth and remediation authority are separate.
incoming_lessons.application: Preserve contract unrealizability, inconsistency, evidence insufficiency and unresolved attribution in experiment analysis; do not silently assign all gaps to builders.
incoming_lessons.limit: E4 changed task, instructions and perspective; a vocabulary field alone has not been shown to fix attribution.

incoming_lessons.lesson: A terminal success record can lose a boundary-stop history.
incoming_lessons.application: Look for retained escalation and disposition events in existing handoffs and report gaps truthfully.
incoming_lessons.limit: No retained stop record does not prove the builder recognized and ignored a stop.

incoming_lessons.lesson: Input selection can manufacture apparent evidence gaps.
incoming_lessons.application: Preserve supplied artifact inventory/bindings and limitations; distinguish missing supplied inputs from absent owning evidence.
incoming_lessons.limit: Hash correctness alone cannot establish inventory completeness.

incoming_lessons.lesson: Pre-execution realizability and acceptance evidence checks prevent different losses.
incoming_lessons.application: Report preparation, reconstruction and repair cost separately from acceptance correctness.

outgoing_lessons.lesson: Manual pilot already distinguishes packet discharge from coverage outside the packet.
outgoing_lessons.relevance: A ledger over listed obligations cannot alone establish decomposition completeness; denominator and omitted-family uncertainty matter.

outgoing_lessons.lesson: Fresh context handoff preserves ownership only when a collector and durable continuation are identified.
outgoing_lessons.source: handoff/START-HERE.md and coordinator-launch-c1-v1.json in manual run
outgoing_lessons.relevance: Separate unfinished handoff, execution completion and accepted result when comparing workflow arms.

outgoing_lessons.lesson: Reviewer replacement after session reset requires explicit continuity provenance.
outgoing_lessons.relevance: Reconstructed same-episode continuity is not fresh independence; final C1 review evidence still pending.

follow_on_owner: Thin coordinator final experiment report and reusable skill proposal
sharing: Repository note plus coordination board reference; supervisor receives bounded lessons; parallel source artifacts remain unchanged
